aic_bic_k_fit_convention_PRIMARY.interpretation: delta_aic_reduced_minus_full ~ 0 (expected: chi2 identical, k_fit identical -- the reduction is invisible to this data, not validated by it). delta_aic_reduced_minus_lcdm > 0 means LCDM is STILL preferred over the reduced model by ~the same margin as round 1 found for the full model (this reduction does not change that verdict either way).
